General Marcus Jonathan in Stormwind will accept a commendation from Elwynn Forest.  Bringing him such a document will reward you with a choice of armor.
If you earn a commendation from one of our Marshals, then bring it to me.  It will be good for one of our Lion Emblem gloves.
Kill 8 Dragonmaw Raiders, 3 Dragonmaw Bonewarders, and a Dragonmaw Battlemaster.

Throm-ka, $c. There is no time to waste. Orcs of the Dragonmaw clan have fortified themselves in the valley to the south of here. $b$bThey have denied the Warchief's mandate, leaving us only one course of action. We will eliminate them so that they will no longer dirty the name of the Horde.
Talk to Kelt Thomasin.

Hello there, $n. I've heard much about your exploits, and must say I'm honored to meet you. I don't suppose you've heard the story of Ol' Kelt? Ah, well, Ol' Kelt--Kelt Thomasin, that is--was once considered one of the finest hunters in all the realm. There wasn't much he hadn't done, but then, one day, he became obsessed with an ancient story... a myth, really. Well, as the stories go, a huge threshadon lives in the waters of the lake. Hogwash, if you ask me. If you're interested, you might talk to Kelt.

Great Mammoda. Enormous, she was, with claws and teeth like swords. Now, I was caught off my guard, but I don't think being ready would have helped my cause much. One swipe and poof! Darkness. They say I'm lucky to walk now...$b$bWell, not much enjoyment to be had in hearing that old story now, is there? Anyways, $n, if you'd like to try yourself against her, the Lady of the Loch,
Kill Maruk Wyrmscale$B$BReport to Valstag Ironjaw in Menethil Harbor.

Other than you, we sent two scouts through Algaz.  Only one returned.  Here's what he discovered:$B$BThe Dragonmaws sent one of their Lieutenants, Maruk Wyrmscale, to organize a crew of orcs in Algaz and cut off the land route to Menethil Harbor!$B$BWe have to stop this, now.  Take out Maruk, and then report to Valstag Ironjaw in Menethil Harbor.$B$BMaruk is headquartered in a small cave, across a pond between the second and third tunnels of Algaz.  Menethil is through Algaz, then west along the road.
This will start the Bloodstone Pendant quest line...<NYI>
Bring 5 Scorched Hearts to Orgnil Soulscar in Razor Hill.

My scouts report that some of the Durotar wildlife have become infected with a demonic taint.  They were seen to the north and west.$B$BThey wander among their brethren as normal beasts, but evil powers flow through them, and burning within each one is a heart scorched by black magic.$B$BThese beasts must be destroyed!$B$BIf you find such an animal while you explore Durotar, kill it and collect its Scorched Heart.  Bring the hearts to me and I will have them studied, then destroyed.
Bring 6 Small Scorpid Carapaces to Kor'ghan in Sen'jin Village.

You would do well to learn how dangerous this land can be, $c.$B$BThe wildlife here can teach us such things... if we are wise and observant.$B$BThe scorpids are a perfect example of survival in Durotar. If you are to survive, it would be wise to take on some of their characteristics as your own. Their hardened carapaces can protect you from the harshness of the sun, or even a deadly weapon.$B$BBring me 6 Small Scorpid Carapaces from the Clattering Scorpids, $n, and I shall see about rewarding you justly.
Bring 10 Chunks of Boar Meat to Cook Torka in Razor Hill.

Cook and clean--that's all I do!$B$BYou want to eat, you get me some more meat! I don't have all day to hunt and prepare food for all these louses. You got to learn to pull your own weight around here if you wanna be treated equal.$B$BGet me some Chunks of Boar Meat if you want to make yourself useful... or you don't want to starve to death.
Bring 8 Shimmerweed to Master Vornal in Sen'jin Village.

Truly a spirit of strength resides in your body--or maybe it was only luck, yes?$B$BThat is what the young rely on these days: luck... and the generosity of those more powerful than they. Not many take the time to find their own path. It's always begging for help... always the reward, and never the quest. I'm sure you'll be the same.$B$BBut there is hope. I need one other thing for my potion, $n: 8 shimmerweed herbs. They can be found in Thunder Ridge to the northwest of Razor Hill.

The manor has been keeping tabs on this "C" character you've been dealing with.

Caius must be stopped, and I believe the onus of doing so falls on you. Fortunately, I've devised a plan. Come speak to me when you're ready to clear your name.

Speak with Gregory to begin the ritual.

I wanted to thank you for your efforts, $n. Without you, I'd likely be dead and the servants of the legion would still have possession of this dangerous artifact. I know its difficult to trust an agent of the Lich King, but it is my hope that after this is over we can sway my friend back to the light. It's clear that the man I cared for is still in there. He may only need a nudge.

Come now, we are needed by Gregory to help him complete the ritual. Let us speak again when it's done.
Speak with the Rugged Traveler.

Had to be sure we could trust you. These kind of friends are hard to come by. 

There's a malignancy growing, a sinister faction within Azeroth. Both the Horde and Alliance are unwittingly working towards their own ends. Slowing their advances and forming information networks are all we have resources for.

Take this, raise your spirits, and harken back to better days. There will be a time soon where we need our bolstered numbers for a show of force.

Use a rock or something to dislodge parts of the mech.

Lying on the shore, half-lost in the afternoon spray, is a strange metal contraption. It looks like some kind of mech, but you have never seen anything like it before. You notice a label on its side that reads "Property of D.E.L.T.A.: Deepsea Exploration and Liquefaction Technologies Alliance". You also spot a small compartment that you might be able to open.
Find a use for the Guided Buoyancy Accelerant

You wonder why this mech was crashed here, and what this liquid is for. Maybe you can use it to reach the nearby islands and oil rig that seem to be connected to this mysterious organization. Opening the vial, a mildly intoxicating fruity aroma greets your nose.
Explain the book situation to Doctor Jurgens' colleague, Nami, in Winterspring.

I'm the chief engineer, founder and lead researcher of the Deepsea Exploration and Liquefaction Technologies Alliance. I've nearly finished my latest experiment, and I need your help! I am working on a special device to geolocate resource-rich dimensions.

To complete my construction, I need something back: a book of arcane formulas that I lent to an old colleague of mine, Nami, who continues her work in Winterspring.

Retrieve the book for me and you'll be included as a published contributor!
Locate the Red Bag that Nami in Everlook lost in a zeppelin mishap over Burning Steppes.

What you want is safely hidden, and I can only hope the same can be said for what I'm looking for.

I had a red bag containing some valuable tooling that I use for electro-optics. But, I lost it in a zeppelin accident over Burning Steppes! The bag could still be there, but with orcs, ogres, and poachers, I've had to put my work on hold.

If you can locate it and bring it back to me, I'll let you have Jurgens' old book.

Recover the rest of the materials and return to Nami in Everlook.

Picking up the bag, you immediately notice it's nearly empty. Somehow you get the impression Nami wont trade the book for the bag by itself. But what's not empty, is the camp. You'd better defend yourself and keep your eyes peeled for more of this stuff.
Return to the D.E.L.T.A lab with the book Jurgens was looking for.
Nami hands over Jurgens' book. With it safely stowed, you begin the long journey back to the other side of the world.

Use the Distant Communication Device to send the signal to Jurgens at either Tirisfal Glades or Westfall
Then, assist him in demonstrating the capabilities of his elecro transmitter.

Join me in this historic experiment and witness the wonders of my invention! I've calculated two locations with suitable geothermic bioflux energy. With manual-auto-locking phasers, I'm ready to send us to the coordinates within compatible regions.

Once you're at compatible coordinates, use this remote transponder to send the signal to me. I'll configure the warp transmitter to fold the space between here, and there.

What I'm saying is, I'll meet you there when you say you're ready!
Orthas needs you to recover his missing armor from the corpse of an Abomination somewhere in Plaguewood.

Great job with the hammer, $c. Next up is me armor. Definitely need that back to move on to the great beyond.

Only problem is it's in the eh... innards o' one of them abominations. I know, I know, it's askin' a lot, but ye gotta understand I was once a mighty thane under the mountain! I simply can't move on knowin' that the ancestral armor of me clan is dissolving in the gutjuice of a giant rotting mountain o' meat!

<You hear a disembodied voice in your head as you touch the small chest> 

Can't be thankin' ye enough, $n. Not how ye'd be expecting it to turn out, no doubt! Just so you aren't too sour about it, I've got something for ye that I've no more use for that I think ye might find useful.

Good luck to ye, $n. Ah, one last thing... if ye happen to see a giant floating necropolis in the distance someday soon, I'd be turnin' tail and runnin' if I were ye. Hah!
Observe Orthas as he moves on from this world.

<You hear the disembodied voice of Orthas in your mind>

'Ere we are then. Let's get on with it, shall we?
Return Nostro's Compendium of Dragon Slaying to the Athenaeum.

You have uncovered something of great importance. This book is unlike any that you have seen.$B$BIt would appear as if someone or something has managed to shatter the seal of Athenaeum. The text within is garbled and barely legible.
Speak with Gatekeeper Rageroar at Ursolan.

There is much more to be done in our fight against the satyr, $n.

If you wish be of further help, speak with Gatekeeper Rageroar at the camps of Ursolan to the north. He will know where to use your abilities best. You should find Ursolan to the north of here.
Kill Master Feardred, and bring his amulet to Korsa.

Many satyr corrupt Azshara, but none are as terrible as the Legashi. Led by Varrox Bleakhoof, their camps litter the northern peninsula. They have driven us from our homes, and I fear they will ransack Ursolan before long.

We must strike back if we are to have any chance of survival.

Master Feardred, a servant of Varrox, oversees a nearby camp to the south. You can see it from here. Feardred is a key target in weakening Varrox's forces. Kill him, and bring me his amulet.
Find the Blackmaw scouting party near the Legashi camps east of Ursolan.

Not long ago I sent a party of scouts to gather information on the Legashi stronghold and possibly find our chieftain. They have yet to return. I am beginning to fear the worst.

The Legashi have many camps to the east of here. If any members of the party are still alive they are likely somewhere nearby.
Kill $1oa Legashi Hellraisers, $2oa Legashi Soulstealers, and $3oa Legashi Blackguards for Korsa outside Legashi Stronghold.

The satyr within the Legashi stronghold are even more fearsome than those of the outer camps. When our party was discovered, we found ourselves overwhelmed.

One of us was slain, and another captured. I was the only one able to successfully retreat. I cannot return to Rageroar with my head hung in shame, but I cannot fight the Legashi alone, either.

I ask you, then, to assist me in weakening the satyr's forces. Go into their stronghold and slay them.
Help Graal break out of Legashi Stronghold, then inform Korsa outside Legashi Stronghold.

You there, $r!

These fiends ambushed my scouting party, and have taken me captive. I don't know what plans they have for me, but I don't intend to find out. I must escape and return to Ursolan; no doubt Korsa is worried about me.

While I would love to break out of this cage and leave a trail of satyr corpses in my wake, I'm afraid I'm slightly outnumbered.

Perhaps you share my hatred for the fiends, and would help me escape?
Return to Gatekeeper Rageroar at Ursolan.

With the Legashi stronghold weakened, we can return to Ursolan in honor.

Go ahead of me, and inform Gatekeeper Rageroar of the situation here.
Speak to Gorn One Eye in Timbermaw Hold and ask him to provide reinforcements.

With the satyr weakened, now is the time to mount a counter-offensive. Prince Halanox, commander of the Legashi Stronghold, will be our target. However, we still lack the numbers to face him head-on.

Since the Legashi drove us out we have been cut off from the furbolgs of Timbermaw Hold. We could call upon them for reinforcements, but we will need an emissary. You will be that emissary, $n.

Go to Timbermaw Hold and find a furbolg named Gorn One Eye. He will provide us with the soldiers we need.
Speak to Elder Bramblesnap about Furze's illness.

<Furze lets loose an ugly, hacking, cough.>

Hear me, $r, I haven't much strength to speak. I am stricken by an illness unlike any I have ever known. It is as if my blood itself is aflame, and my very essence is coming undone. I can hardly move, much less fetch help.

Please, go find Elder Bramblesnap. Her tent is just northwest of here. She will know what to do.
Find a way to get Legashi Firewater in the Legashi Encampment.

Furze is not the first with his affliction. Since the Legashi's attacks against us began, many Blackmaw have presented with a similar illness. Each one eventually fell to corruption, becoming mindless and destructive.

I have been working towards a cure. My studies indicate that one could possibly be made by transmuting the Legashi's own firewater, but I cannot acquire it myself.

You might find firewater, or a way to brew it, in the Legashi camps to the east. You would be a great help in doing so.
Use the Satyrweed Tincture on $1oa Mosshoof Coursers or Thunderhead Skystormers after weakening them.

I have transmuted the firewater into a tincture which I believe will be the key to undoing the Legashi's corruption. Eager as I am to ease the suffering of the Blackmaw, it must be tested.

I have seen many of the coursers and skystormers east of Ursolan suffering from the satyr's corruption. They will serve as our test subjects.

Go, and test my would-be cure on the afflicted beasts. Before giving the tincture the beast must be weakened to ensure it can be administered with little resistance.
Administer Bramblesnap's Panacea to Furze.

I must say, $c. I have not felt this optimistic in some time. This tincture could be the panacea that saves us from the satyr's ever-expanding blight. Even if we remain in these camps for the rest of our lives we will stand strong and free of corruption.

Go to Furze and give him this panacea. He has suffered for long enough. Return to me to report any findings.
Plant the Timbermaw War Banner at the Legashi Stronghold in Azshara. Kill Prince Halanox, report your victory to Gatekeeper Rageroar at Ursolan.

I will send the reinforcements to Ursolan at once. 

Take this banner. When you are ready to face Halanox, plant it in his demonic summoning circle. This will provoke him, and signal our warriors to strike.

Once Halanox is defeated, inform Gatekeeper Rageroar.
Find a Legashi Firewater Recipe from satyr in the Legashi Encampment.

It appears this cauldron could be used to brew the firewater that Elder Bramblesnap is after.

If only you knew how. Surely, one of the satyr in the Legashi Encampment must carry a recipe.
Bring $1oa Satyrweed and a Fel Mote to the Legashi Cauldron in the Legashi Encampment.

The recipe reads:

Harvest ye the sprout of hell
bushel o' five will serve ye well
mixed with mote of demon's power
shall usher in their final hour
Bring the Legashi Firewater to Elder Bramblesnap at Ursolan.

As the satyrweed and fel mote splash into the boiling liquid, a plume of noxious gas emerges.

Best to hold your nose, quickly grab a sample, and bring it back to Elder Bramblesnap.
Kill Chieftain Bloodmaw and bring his mace to Gorn One Eye in Timbermaw Hold.

When the Legashi overran the Blackmaw, the rest of the Timbermaw sealed their passage to the hold to keep out the satyr. We had no idea they lived on as refugees.

I would gladly aid my brethren, but we are fighting our own battles. Like the Legashi threaten the Blackmaw, the Deadwood do likewise to us. We haven't many warriors to spare.

The Deadwood chieftain, Bloodmaw, is in Felpaw Village to the south. Eliminating him would greatly ease our struggle. Bring me his mace, and you will have our aid.
Bring a Mammoth Shark Steak to Berdun Cliffbrew at Talrendis Point in Azshara.

If ye fancy yourself a real angler, there's bigger fish out here than ye can catch with a rod.

Mammoth Sharks lurk in the deepest waters of the northern an' southern coasts. They swim far out, right before the sea floor drops away into the great ocean.

They're mighty big; I'd advise ye take a group of anglers with ye. 

Dwarf like me? I prefer dry land. Those sharks'd swallow me in one bite.

If ye do go hunting one, bring me a cut o' the meat. I'd be mighty thankful.
Bring a Mammoth Shark Steak to Berdun Cliffbrew at Talrendis Point in Azshara.
Bring a Mammoth Shark Steak to Berdun Cliffbrew at Talrendis Point in Azshara.
Bring the Orders from the High Priestess to Shen'Dar Village and present it to whomever is in charge there.

The cultist you just killed dropped what appears to be orders from a high priestess of the Cult of Al'Akir. It makes mention of a spy in Shen'dar Village and cult operations in a place called Falaath Village. The authorities at Shen'dar Village will want to learn of this.
Return the Rusty Gadget to The Strange Hermit in Shadowgale Forest.

<As the roiling currents that hold the Wind Hollow together begin to dissipate, a small metal device tumbles to the ground at your feet. It appears to be some sort of mechanical gadget. The Strange Hermit mentioned he was still missing some equipment. He might be interested in this.>
Seek out the Al'Aketh Turncoat in the Shen'dar Highlands.

There is a turncoat amongst the Al'Aketh. They claim to know the cult's true intentions for the island and want to come in, but will only do so with assurances of protection.

This defector is hiding at a house just northwest of Valanaar, just inside the highlands. I need someone who can discreetly go there, find the traitor, find out and escort him back to us. This might be a trap, but if this information is as important as this traitor claims, it's worth some risk.
Slay $1oa Wind Hollows.

When our home started to fall into the sky that fateful night, it's as if the elements themselves were waiting to consume us. Wind spirits began appearing as we were fleeing, and to our dismay they began attacking the fleeing survivors.

We lost many villagers to the sky, but even more to the relentless anger of those wind spirits. I don't know if it was our village falling into the sky, but they are extremely dangerous.

If you are able, please put them to rest.
Escort NAME to safety.
NYI
